issue.title: bench: `WalletLoadingDescriptors` slowdown
issue.body:
Locally running this takes ~180s:
```bash
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletEncryptDescriptors                      | ✓ Passed  | 3 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletIsMineDescriptors                       | ✓ Passed  | 1 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletIsMineMigratedDescriptors               | ✓ Passed  | 2 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletLoadingDescriptors                      | ✓ Passed  | 186 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletMigration                               | ✓ Passed  | 6 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WriteBlockBench                               | ✓ Passed  | 0 s
```
Looks like it's also slowed down in the CI, compared to all other benches (which avg ~0s): https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/actions/runs/38328088251/job/115071335648#step:9:4651:
```bash

tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletEncryptDescriptors                      | ✓ Passed  | 1 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletIsMineDescriptors                       | ✓ Passed  | 0 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletIsMineMigratedDescriptors               | ✓ Passed  | 0 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletLoadingDescriptors                      | ✓ Passed  | 17 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WalletMigration                               | ✓ Passed  | 1 s
tool_bench_sanity_check.py --bench=WriteBlockBench                               | ✓ Passed  | 0 s

```
